rule: Width of every card manage_diagram creates on a data model; it cannot be changed there
evidence: Probe map 18 Oct 2026: every data model card is 200 px wide

rule: The server never makes a card shorter than this
evidence: Probe map: a card with no or one attribute and no footer is 100 px

rule: Card height is card_height_base plus attribute_row_height per attribute plus footer_height with a footer; at least card_height_min
evidence: Probe map: 2/3+footer/6+footer/8 attributes give 112/208/286/268 px

rule: Height the server adds for each attribute; it does not allow for text that wraps
evidence: Probe map

rule: Height the server adds for a footer of any length
evidence: Probe map: footers of 14 and 42 characters both add 70 px

rule: Extra space kept below each row because the editor may grow a card whose title or attributes wrap; it never shrinks
evidence: As for interaction flows

rule: Horizontal space between neighbouring cards in a row: room for two crow's feet and a short label
evidence: Exemplars: 60 px between 120 px cards; 200 px cards get a little more

rule: Vertical space from the bottom of the tallest card in a row to the top of the next row; holds the bend of every line between the rows
evidence: Exemplars: 60 px between 80 px rows with no fields; cards with fields and labels need more

rule: Horizontal space between separate groups of related objects
evidence: Keeps groups that share no line visibly apart

rule: Horizontal space between a parent card and a column of child cards beside it; the lines' shared vertical runs in its middle
evidence: Mortgage exemplar: 60 px between Residential Loan Application and its stacked children

rule: Vertical space between cards stacked in a column beside their parent
evidence: Mortgage exemplar: 20-60 px

rule: Children of one card laid out in a row under it before the childless ones move into columns beside it
evidence: Seven 200 px cards and their gaps are about 1900 px: one screen at 100% zoom

rule: Childless children stacked in one column beside their parent before a second column starts on the other side
evidence: Keeps a column under about 1500 px with fields shown

rule: Widest the groups of related objects may run side by side before the next group starts a new band below
evidence: About two screens at 100% zoom

rule: Vertical space between bands of groups
evidence: row_gap plus room for lines between bands

rule: Objects on one data model before the plan warns it will be hard to read
evidence: Exemplars hold 8 to 31 objects

rule: Most fields shown on one card; the rest are listed in the plan as not shown
evidence: Keeps a card under about 220 px tall; chosen with Xavery 18 Oct 2026

rule: Longest field title written; longer ones are cut with an ellipsis and the full text goes into the description
evidence: Two lines on a 200 px card

rule: Longest line label written
evidence: The server wraps labels at about 20 characters

rule: Written before the name of a field that identifies the record (key primary)
evidence: Energy and Utilities exemplar marks identifying fields with #

rule: Write an entity's API name as its card footer when it differs from its name
evidence: Energy and Utilities exemplar shows the API name under each object name

rule: Add a card titled Key left of the diagram listing the colours and line ends used
evidence: A data model's colours mean nothing without a key; a note is a fixed 150 x 150 px and too small

rule: Space between the legend note and the cards
Width of the canvas manage_diagram accepts positions in on a blank level (from x = 0)
evidence: Probe maps 18 Oct 2026

rule: Height of the canvas on a blank level (from y = 0)
evidence: Probe maps

rule: Once a level has content the canvas is the content's bounding box plus this fraction of its width and height on each side
evidence: Probe map: content 2000 x 1200 at (0, 0) gives the canvas (-1000, -600) 4000 x 2400
